title: Delta Log + Lightweight Playbook: customer signals and rapid probes
body:
Purpose: quick synthesis of the last 6 customer conversations (enterprise + PLG) focused on inference cost, latency, and rollout / routing pain points. Goal is to surface low-effort probes we can run in weeks and a small set of prioritized asks for product/infra to evaluate.

Executive summary:
- Signal: customers are repeatedly calling out unpredictable per-call unit cost when traffic bursts, and opaque routing behavior when dedicated pools are exhausted.
- Impact: 3 customers flagged potential migration away from Redwood Dedicated unless we can demonstrate predictable latency and a clear tiered fallback that preserves pricing SLAs.
- Quick asks (MVP probes): (1) transparent cost delta calc per-route (sampled over 1 day) (2) explicit fallback policy UI toggle + canary (3) simple latency SLA dashboard for top 10 callers.

Raw signals and illustrative quotes (combined notes):
- "We love the throughput, but our finance team freaks out at month-end because the per-call cost spikes on Tuesday nights." — Fintech scale customer
- "When our dedicated pool is saturated, requests seem to switch models and our customers get inconsistent outputs." — e-commerce personalization team
- "We need a 'safety valve' rollout path for new model versions without traffic loss." — internal platform team at large enterprise

Thematic clusters (why different from previous synths):
1) Cost transparency + sampling: customers don't need full accounting, they need representative deltas and clear levers they can toggle. Not asking for per-token forensic exports — asking for digestible, explainable deltas.
2) Fallback semantics & observability: requests routing to cheaper model variants cause functional divergence (quality regressions). Customers want to opt-in to 'quality-first' vs 'cost-first' fallback policies.
3) Rapid rollouts with traffic safety: canary rules that are model-variant aware and that surface potential semantic drift before full rollout.
4) PLG friction: lower-usage accounts hit rate limits unpredictably when shared pools rebalance — need better UX and signals for the user.

Prioritized feature requests (proposed priority and RICE-like reasoning):
- Transparent Delta Report (priority: high, effort: low-medium). Short description: generate a daily sample that shows cost per route pre/post change with 95th percentile token counts, delta explanation. Value: immediate customer reassurance and sales enabling.
- Fallback Policy Toggle (priority: high, effort: medium). Short description: in Console > Routes allow admins to set fallback policy: preserve-quality (avoid model variant that fails eval set) vs cost-saver (prefer cheaper variants). Include a warning banner.
- Latency SLA Heatmap for Top Callers (priority: medium, effort: low). Short description: per-customer latency distribution with flags when 99th > target.
- Canary Semantic Drift Alert (priority: medium, effort: medium-high). Short description: run small evals of new variant on production-like prompts and surface quality regressions before primary rollout.
- Burst-aware Quotas (priority: low, effort: medium). Short description: soft-burst allowances for PLG tier with explicit cost ceilings and notifications.

Low-effort probes (week-by-week experiments we can run without major infra changes):
Week 0: carve out 48h sampled delta reports for 5 pilot customers (CS + eng pair). Output: PDF summary + 3 example requests showing token delta.
Week 1: configure an opt-in fallback label on two customers' routes and observe behavior for 2 weeks (no UI surface yet; flag in config only).
Week 2: create a synthetic latency heatmap for top 3 customers using existing trace data and share with customers for feedback.
Week 3: A/B test an email notification that explains burst impact and shows projected cost under current profile.

Risk flags and open questions:
- Data privacy: sampling must avoid exposing PII; need guidance from security/compliance before sharing sample requests. Refer to SECURE-REQ-21.
- Billing alignment: finance wants an audited calculation for refunds — the delta report is advisory, not legal. Legal/finance review needed if customers request credits.
- Observability scale: generating heatmaps for many customers could increase observability egress costs — we should pilot with 5 accounts.

Proposed owners and quick timeline (CS + Eng collaboration):
- Owner (CS): Asha Patel — coordinate pilots and customer comms.
- Owner (Eng): Mateo Ruiz — build sampled delta job + expose read-only report.
- Owner (Product): Jing Wei — spec fallback toggle UX and canary evaluation triggers.
Timeline: 6-week pilot plan with two paying customers and one PLG high-volume account.

Customer sample plan (pilot candidates and why):
- Fintech A (sensitive to month-end cost variance) — willing to trial delta report.
- Retail B (observed quality regressions on fallback) — candidate for fallback opt-in testing.
- PLG scale user C (burst behavior) — good for quota/burst probe.

Communication & sales enablement artifacts to prepare:
- 1-pager: "How Redwood shows cost deltas" (for AEs) — short, non-technical, includes sample screenshot.
- FAQ snippet: "What to do if delta report shows a spike" — CS playbook.
- Email template for pilot invitation + opt-in checkbox in Console.

Next steps (immediate):
- [ ] CS: validate pilot candidates and secure opt-in from 3 customers (owner: Asha).
- [ ] Eng: prototype a sampled delta pipeline using last 7 days of logs (owner: Mateo).
- [ ] Product: wireframe fallback toggle and canary alerts (owner: Jing).
- [ ] Legal/Finance: advise on wording for advisory-only reports and refund policy trigger points.

Notes to self / raw fragments from interviews (keep, unedited):
- "If we could see 'what changed' between model variants at a glance, we'd sleep better."
- "We don't need every token; 5 examples + a percentile chart is enough."
- "Make the fallback opt-in at route level, not org level."

Appendix: quick links and references
- Related Confluence note: CONFLUENCE-9876 (customer-signal-hub)
- Jira: JIRA-CS-4021 (pilot: delta-report)
- Slack thread: #cs-field-notes/2029-11-10 (raw call notes)

Status: ready to run pilots pending engineering feasibility check on sampling PII scrubbing and an initial read-only report mock.

-- end of doc --
